تقوضيت (form VI)
# تُقُوضِيتُ (tuqūḍītu) /tu.quː.dˤiː.tu/: first-person singular past passive of تَقَاضَى (taqāḍā)
# تُقُوضِيتَ (tuqūḍīta) /tu.quː.dˤiː.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of تَقَاضَى (taqāḍā)
# تُقُوضِيتِ (tuqūḍīti) /tu.quː.dˤiː.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of تَقَاضَى (taqāḍā)
# تُقُوضِيَتْ (tuqūḍiyat) /tu.quː.dˤi.jat/: third-person feminine si
